name: session_start
title: Start Issue branch
description: Create a branch linked to an Issue (shown in the Development section of the Issue)

branch.description: Name of the branch to create

base.description: Base branch (default: chosen by readiness, else develop_branch from the config)

checkout.description: Kept for compatibility; has no effect

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

branch.description: Branch created (or to be created), with the Issue number appended

base.description: Base branch the branch starts from

stackedOn.description: Issue number whose branch this one is stacked on (omitted when not stacked)

workDirectory.description: Absolute path of the work directory (omitted when it could not be created)

leftovers.description: Earlier merged PRs whose local cleanup is left undone (omitted when there is none)

pullRequest.description: Merged PR of the current branch whose local cleanup with session_finish is left (owner/repo/N)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
